annotation.title_clean: Standards Document: Operation of Aircraft, Part IV – International Operations – Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS)
annotation.title_en: Standards Document: Operation of Aircraft, Part IV – International Operations – Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS)
annotation.venue: Civil Aviation Authority of Fiji – Standards Documents
annotation.summary_en: Fiji CAAF Standards Document transposing ICAO Annex 6 Part IV, setting requirements for international operations of certificated remotely piloted aircraft systems: RPAS operator certificate, C2 link oversight, remote pilot qualifications, detect-and-avoid, recorders, maintenance, fatigue, security and dangerous goods.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators need an RPAS operator certificate (ROC) from the State of the Operator before international RPAS operations.
C2 Link service must be covered by an approved service level agreement and State oversight; lost-link procedures are mandatory.
Detect-and-avoid capability required for IFR RPAS, and the remote pilot must be able to intervene in automated avoidance.
RPA over 2,250 kg and remote pilot stations must carry recorder systems, with limits on non-investigation use of recordings.
Remote pilot-in-command controls only one RPA at a time; applies only to the certified category, not Open or Specific.
